spanish: Y si hace caer diente de su siervo o diente de su sierva, al libre lo enviará bajo su diente.
grammarChanges: Reordered the clause so the unnamed Hiphil 3ms agent is the implicit subject of "hace caer" and "diente de su siervo o diente de su sierva" becomes its direct object, instead of diente being the subject that "hace caer".
Changed "debajo de" to "bajo" so the preposition stays open between the spatial and compensatory senses of תחת instead of locking to the spatial "underneath".
Changed "a libre" to "al libre" to mark the definite article present on the adjective in לַֽחָפְשִׁי.
